quality_presentation: Raw objective remains family-specific. Paired percentage gain or loss relative to a named common-kernel/classical comparator may be shown; do not normalize all methods to the best saved feasible value and label near100percent as performance. A missing/unsupported/error result is null with its reason, not zero reward.
timing_presentation: Nominal internal wall targets are not equal end-to-end hard deadlines. Report actual wrapper/native plus repair CPU/wall, preprocessing and batch shared setup separately; show quality versus measured time where available.
uncertainty: Source/pair-cluster bootstrap2000 replicates with fixed seed261004, preserving both constraint sides and method seeds. Four authoring-block contrasts are separately displayed; source intervals alone cannot establish a model-population effect or fix conditional transport selection.
curve_policy: Use every predeclared target0.1/1/5 and every original authoring prefix, not a favorable point/subset. Kernel reward progress is measured from actual feasible incumbent traces; do not label patch count or eliminated-vertex fraction as elapsed time.
claims: No TEST-based program/library/kernel/selector tuning. Classical initializer/search gains and unique witness/LLM effects are reported separately. Null or negative contrasts remain visible. No superiority or acceptance is assumed.
